name: nme
description: Minimal, fast, end-to-end encrypted group video meetings.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nme/core && npm run build -w @nme/server && npm run build -w @nme/web
scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild build -project apps/ios/NME.xcodeproj -scheme NME -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath /tmp/NMEDerivedData -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath /tmp/NMEPackages CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet
scripts.ios:test: xcodebuild test -project apps/ios/NME.xcodeproj -scheme NME -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro,OS=latest' -derivedDataPath /tmp/NMEDerivedData -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath /tmp/NMEPackages CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -parallel-testing-enabled NO -quiet
